ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the provided financial document:  Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited reported strong Q1 FY27 collections of Rs. 713 crores and successful initial bookings for Birla Taranya. A material impact is the divestment of Century Pulp and Paper, which significantly reduced net debt to near zero, substantially strengthening the balance sheet for future growth and business development. While net sales were muted this quarter (Rs. 329 crores) due to cancellations, which management claims are being re-booked at higher prices, and an absence of major launches, the company plans substantial launches in Q3/Q4 FY27 and is strategically expanding into high-potential redevelopment projects in the MMR.
